headline: Three shows still have no outcome four days on, and no reply has landed in three days. Initials ticked up to 41.

sections.title: Do today
sections.text: Log the three call results before anything else. Robert on Wednesday, luca and Evan on Thursday, all three still sitting with no outcome, and Joshua Haber has been Booked since Aug 10 with nothing after it. Those four names are the whole of August's cash, EUR 5,000 of 30,000 with eight working days left. Nothing sent from here replies in time to close this month.

sections.title: Watch
sections.text: The send split. Yesterday was 41 initials against 398 follow ups, near ten to one. Replies track initials at a four day lag and show no measurable link to follow ups, so that ratio is the number that decides September.
